brief: A ledger spine like icon.ledger.closed, but this one you wrote by hand and the clerk may never rename, merge or delete it. Add a visible clasp or a wax seal on the spine, and make the leather a touch darker. It must be tellable from the ordinary spine at a glance on the shelf, not just up close. Same size and position as the closed spine so the shelf stays even.
sketchNote: The closed spine, darker leather, with a clasp poking out the right side. Same size and position as the plain spine so the shelf stays even.
use: the spine of a hand-written ledger on the shelf, and its lock on the Shelf tab's cards
